name: Train Molester Big-Titty Undercover Agent ~Hot and Sexy Prey~
detailed_description:
Her job was to go undercover and arrest molesters... But little did she know, this dream job would soon become a brutal nightmare...

・All exits have been blocked… There is no escaping now.

・These rapists crave revenge and will do whatever they have to do to get it.

・Locked in a room, she is continuously trained both day and night...

・With her body and mind broken, she slowly gives in...

Story

The heroine of this story, Asami Mizuse, is a member of an organization secretly established by the government. By dressing provocatively in front of repeat offenders, they plan on luring sexual predators out and arresting them after gaining irrefutable evidence. This powerful organization is a modern countermeasure against molestation. Asami is on the train, carrying out her usual part of the investigation. While on board, she is molested by her target, but there is something different about the way he is groping her. The man's overly bold molestation gradually escalates, and before she knows it, she is being molested by passengers other than her target as well. They all turn out to be molesters who Asami arrested in the past. They work together to molest the undercover cop, getting their revenge on her. However, it doesn't stop at just touching. In fact, touching is only just the beginning. Asami is soon shoved off the train and forced into a room. What will become of our beautiful, busty heroine...?

Characters

・Asami Mizuse (VA: Kikyo Yamamoto)

The heroine of this story. A 25-year-old woman who works investigating molestation cases. She is highly ambitious and one of the elite members of her organization.

She didn't think much of her breast size as a student, often being teased by the boys in the school. But ever since she started this job, she has become proud of what she's got.

She has a high sense of pride and is strong-willed no matter who she is interacting with. But despite this, she easily crumbles when persistently teased.

She has no experience with men and thinks sex is impure.

・Shuri Kitami (VA: Azuki Amasake)

The heroine's colleague. She quietly supports our determined heroine from behind the scenes.

She is free-spirited and has a personality that is the polar opposite of Asami, but for some reason, they get along well.

She has two younger brothers who are kidnapped in the second half of the story.

Features

This is a visual novel where players assume the role of the protagonist and progress through the story. Enjoy loads of gorgeous artwork, intense scenes, and next-level voice acting as you sit back, relax, and experience the story! There is also a major choice at the end of the game that affects the ending. What will become of our heroines Asami and Shuri?!
